footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to NextEra: includes an $802M income tax benefit, $1.5B of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 10.7% to $27.4B in 2025. Operating income rose 10.7% to $8.3B, a 30.2% margin.
Net income fell 1.6% to $6.8B, or $3.30 per share. Operating cash flow was $12.5B and free cash flow $3.8B, versus $5.3B; NextEra returned $4.7B through dividends.
sources: NextEra Energy, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
